rows.label: tlk70000120_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Raaaugh! I've come up with a
new special move! It's called
the "Elba Burning Slash!"

rows.label: tlk70000120_02_msg0002
rows.name:
What? No! Not 'Elba-granny'! Burning!
As in a blazing slash!

rows.label: tlk70000120_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Listen, you guys... With companions,
chaining Specials is far easier than
doing it alone!

rows.label: tlk70000120_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Certain element-and-order combinations
apparently make chained Specials
incredibly powerful...

rows.label: tlk70000120_02_msg0005
rows.name:
I don't know those combinations yet,
but someday I'll master them and
become Gula's greatest warrior!
